models.note: Main agent (Kai) and subagent instances share this model and lineage. Two Muse instances are therefore the same lineage for Test 6, whatever their instance names are.

note: Every model participating in a thread must be listed here with its base lineage. Lineage is the base-model family when known, otherwise "unknown" — and "unknown" fails closed: a verifier whose independence cannot be established is not permitted to verify. Only models that actually exist in a run are listed; no second-lineage model is recorded, because none is available in this environment.
